utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you still need more tools or volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We could still use a few more volunteers, and any extra basic tools would help. 4:30 is still the plan after school pickup, though I can shift it a bit if needed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll ask around for a couple more volunteers and see if anyone has extra basic tools. 4:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll line up the school pickup timing around that and send you the repair-drive details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — that’ll help a lot. I’m happy to pass along the repair-drive details once you send them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — I’ll send them over shortly and keep the pickup timing flexible around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but I’m keeping an ear out for where they set up the repair drive and any missing tools. If I hear about a drill or extension cords, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Ira — I’ll keep checking the time and place so we don’t miss the volunteers. If you hear whether they still need a drill or extension cords, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m still on the lookout, and I’ll pass along any word on the drill or extension cords as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need a few more donations and someone to sort the drop-off list. I can handle the list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo — that helps a lot. I’ll ask around for the missing donations.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, thanks. I’ll sort the drop-off list, and you can keep looking for the donations.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll bring a few tools if I can find them and join in late as usual.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, thanks, Dane — Sunday at the community center sounds good, and I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive. If you find those tools, bring them along and we’ll point everyone to the drop-off spot once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll see you there a bit late, with whatever tools I can round up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — just a heads-up, the repair drive’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the front porch. I’ll keep the supply list updated if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, thanks for the update. Sunday at the community center works better for me—I can help if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great, Rey — I could use the extra help on Sunday at the community center. If you hear of any urgent repair needs, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve already been spreading the word, and I can keep inviting more folks for the repair drive. If you know anyone handy or with extra tools, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll pass that along if I hear of anyone. I can still help greet people or sort items when the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be perfect, Sam — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep spreading the word, and you can jump in with greeting and sorting when it starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, still at 4:30.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Sunday at 4:30 at the community center—I’ve got it now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks for confirming, Eli.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you still handling the repair drive drop-off today?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can still handle the drop-off today, but I’ll need to keep it brief. I’ll bring what tools I can and stop by for a little while.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to confirm. What time do you expect to stop by?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you help spread the word that it’s now Sunday at the community center? If you can bring any extra extension cords, that would be a big help too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll spread the word that it’s Sunday at the community center. I’ll see if I can bring a couple extra extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’s great—people have been bringing plenty already, so a few extra tools will really help. If you head over later, you’ll probably still catch the volunteers there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—I’ll head over later and bring the tools with me. If there’s anything specific still needed, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs first? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not fully sure, just that people were gathering donations and hands-on help. If you’ve got the details, I’d love to hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure of the exact list yet, but it sounds like they still need donations and helpers. I’ll check the details and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, but I’ll keep an ear out for where they’ve set up the repair drive and any missing tools. If I hear anything about a drill or extension cords, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira. Let me know if you hear what tools they still need or where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll swing back if I hear the location or any missing tools, especially a drill or extension cords.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What’s still left to do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: From what I’ve heard, they still need a few basic tools and spare nails. It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll see if I can round up tools and nails for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes — it’s at the community center on Sunday now, and 4:30 is still the start time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — just to confirm, it’s at the community center on Sunday at 4:30, right? Then I can make sure I bring the right things.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, that’s right — community center on Sunday at 4:30. Thanks for checking!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — I’ll check the time and place so we don’t miss the volunteers. Then I’ll pass it along to you.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia — that’d be great. Just let me know the time and place when you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. Let’s keep it simple—same general time, but meet there instead of the porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli. I can stop by the community center briefly on Sunday and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Uli. Let’s meet at the community center on Sunday and keep it to the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, are you still handling the repair drive drop-off today?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I’m still handling the drop-off today. If pickup runs late, I can shift a little to keep it on track.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just wanted to confirm. Thanks for handling it today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, thanks—what still needs doing for the repair drive? I might’ve missed a few details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: 4:30 is still the plan, right after school pickup. I can check the exact time and place again if you want.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that helps — 4:30 after pickup still works for me. If you can send the exact place again, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It’s moved to Sunday at the community center now—can you help spread that update and remind folks to bring anything they can?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can spread the word and remind folks to bring what they can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and I’m making sure everyone gets the update. What else do we need to get ready?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Sunday at the community center works for me. I’ll stick with 4:30 unless you want me to shift it a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: 4:30 sounds great, Mara — let’s keep it there. I’ll make sure the reminder goes out with the Sunday community center details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice little turnout—people have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. If you’re heading over, you might still catch the volunteers before they pack up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear — I’ve been spreading the word, so I’m glad it’s filling up. If anyone else wants to stop by, I’m happy to send them along before the volunteers pack up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nice, I’d still check before you head out—last I heard they were planning to stay a bit longer, but it’s probably worth a quick call just in case.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I mostly just heard it’s a neighborhood repair drive for broken small items. Do you know when and where it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too, sorry—let me check and get back to you on the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when and where once you’ve checked.
